mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad-based demand contraction that increases equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below its 2017 base level (100) signals a supply shock regime where corporate profitability declines, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO < 100 instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of PAYEMS increase months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month CPI increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals heightened inflationary pressures that trigger expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL > 0.5pp instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI (CPIAUCSL) signal monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, increasing equity risk and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized signals a late-cycle expansion regime where economic slowdown concerns dominate, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of GDPC1 < 1.5% growth instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
